evaluatorFindings.summary: identity-only-classification, diagnostic-population and benign-heavy-population all read arrivalGateStatuses.identity, which piiArrivalGateStatuses sets from population-report state. Three gates carry one signal; the identity source lane is a precondition, not the source of the status.

Absence cases are checked only for zero public findings; the plan label sensitive:false is never compared. Several such cases are not-established under their contract (context-less collisions, identity-unmatched controls), so the label must not feed an oracle as non-sensitive.

All six records bind the same npm facade SHA-256 across six different source commits. The facade does not identify the native or Wasm build; build identity rests on the source commit and the component hashes in each candidate evidence file.
The latest trusted binding requested only pii:global, so it reports this family as product-family-unavailable. That is recorded activation, not a product claim; a beta.11 binding must request pii:us.
Both population views declare zero sensitive mass, so neither can measure a sensitive miss rate. The other five families have no population entries at all.
